mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past quarter signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, thereby generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers a reduction in labor market uncertainty, fostering investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing below 4.0%, or returns underperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) above their 5-month moving averages signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both exceed 5-month moving averages
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not positively correlate with the GDPC1-INDPRO interaction (Pearson correlation < 0.3) in >60% of triggered instances, or underperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals monetary policy normalization, which reduces risk premiums and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in late-cycle periods do not outperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining below 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly employment (PAYEMS) over the past quarter indicates strengthening labor market conditions, fostering investor optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns underperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the supply index (INDPRO) below 105 signals weakening production capacity, raising concerns about economic stagnation and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO falling below 105, or returns underperform baseline in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and labor participation (PAYEMS) above their 5-month moving averages indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and PAYEMS both exceed 5-month moving averages
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not positively correlate with the GDPC1-PAYEMS interaction (Pearson correlation < 0.3) in >60% of triggered instances, or underperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained increase in demand (GDPC1) above 17200 signals renewed consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in post-shock recovery periods do not outperform baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 exceeding 17200, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year window.
